units.source_text: 宫邸里的气象与往常不同，渐渐富有生气，与一般邸宅差不多了。

en.t: The atmosphere in the residence was unlike before, gradually filling with life until it seemed much like any ordinary mansion.

units.source_text: 那位小姐的姿态也比从前稍稍生动活泼。

en.t: The young lady herself also seemed a little more lively and animated than before.

units.source_text: 源氏公子一直独自沉思：“

en.t: Prince Genji kept thinking to himself,

units.source_text: 如果这个人入新年后完全改了样子，

en.t: If, after the New Year, this person were to change completely,

units.source_text: 变得美丽了，不知是何等模样？”

en.t: and become beautiful, I wonder what she would look like?
